Although we do not find a gradient indicating more adverse effects on the poorest low-wage workers, the adverse effects for poor and low-income low-wage workers help explain why minimum wages do not reduce poverty.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用收入与项目参与调查（SIPP）数据，首次直接估计了最低工资对不同收入-需求比分布位置上低收入家庭中低工资工人的影响。研究发现最低工资对贫困和低收入家庭中已就业低工资工人的就业、工时和收入产生不利影响，而非有利影响，这有助于解释为什么最低工资不能减少贫困。
AI.research_question: 最低工资对不同收入-需求比分布位置家庭中的低工资工人产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 以往研究未直接估计最低工资对不同贫困程度家庭中低工资工人的异质性影响，作者利用SIPP数据（该数据对低收入家庭进行了过度抽样）来填补这一空白，并解释为何最低工资未能减少贫困。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最低工资的就业效应理论（劳动力市场供求框架），以及最低工资与贫困减缓关系的研究脉络。
AI.method: 使用SIPP数据（对低收入家庭过度抽样），对收入-需求比分布不同位置的家庭进行分类，估计最低工资对已就业低工资工人的就业、工时和收入的影响。
AI.findings: 最低工资对贫困和低收入家庭中已就业低工资工人的就业、工时和收入产生不利影响；未发现对最贫困低工资工人有更不利影响的梯度效应；这些不利影响有助于解释最低工资为何不能减少贫困。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次直接估计了最低工资对不同贫困程度家庭中低工资工人的异质性影响，为最低工资与贫困关系的理论讨论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于最低工资对贫困家庭中低工资工人潜在负面影响的重要证据，指出单纯依赖最低工资政策可能无法有效减贫，需辅以其他政策工具。

title: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
affiliations: University of Maryland, College Park and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
detail.abstract:
We study voluntary disclosure when partially naive receivers observe a public signal correlated with the sender’s private information. We develop a framework in which the public signal changes how receivers interpret silence, and derive a closed-form disclosure threshold nesting classical unraveling. A laboratory experiment varying the correlation confirms our predictions: disclosure decreases as the signal becomes more favorable, and receiver guesses upon nondisclosure rise toward it. The public signal can crowd out disclosure, leaving receivers less informed than without it. This informational loss peaks at intermediate correlation, where the signal shifts beliefs yet remains too noisy to substitute for disclosure.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当部分天真的接收者观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公共信号时，自愿披露如何受到影响。作者开发了一个框架，其中公共信号改变了接收者如何解读沉默，并推导出包含经典"unraveling"结果的闭式披露阈值。实验室实验验证了预测：信号越有利，披露越少；未披露时接收者的猜测趋近于该信号。公共信号可能挤出披露，使接收者比没有信号时信息更少，且这种信息损失在中等相关性时达到峰值。
AI.research_question: 当部分天真的接收者能够观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公共信号时，自愿披露行为如何变化？公共信号是否会挤出私人披露，以及对接收者福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中，接收者（如投资者、消费者）在接收自愿披露信息时，往往同时能观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公共信号（如媒体报道、分析师预测、市场数据等）。现有自愿披露理论大多假设接收者只能依赖披露或不披露的信号，忽略了公共信号对"沉默"含义解读的影响。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿披露理论、部分天真（partially naive）接收者模型、信号相关性框架、披露阈值分析（嵌套经典unraveling结果）
AI.method: 理论建模推导闭式披露阈值，辅以实验室实验（通过操纵公共信号与私人信息的相关性强弱）来验证理论预测。
AI.findings: （1）信号越有利，披露越少；（2）未披露时，接收者的猜测会趋近于该公共信号；（3）公共信号会挤出自愿披露，使接收者反而比没有信号时信息更少；（4）这种信息损失在中等相关性时达到峰值——此时信号足以改变信念，但又过于嘈杂无法替代披露。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将公共信号对"沉默"解读的影响引入自愿披露理论，拓展了经典unraveling结果的适用范围；（2）揭示了公共信号可能挤出自愿披露的反直觉理论洞见；（3）刻画了信息损失与信号相关性之间的非线性关系（中等相关性危害最大）。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者理解信息披露环境设计（如强制披露与公共信息发布政策）提供理论依据；（2）提醒信息接收者（如投资者、消费者）不能简单依赖公共信号替代私人披露；（3）为政策制定提供指导：在中等相关性信息环境下，公共信号的引入可能适得其反，需要谨慎设计信息披露制度。

title: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis

detail.title: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
detail.abstract:
U.S. tariff rates in 2025 rose to levels not seen since the Great Depression, yet imports increased. To account for the missing trade collapse, we develop an open-economy New Keynesian model with tariff heterogeneity, inventories, and shocks to investment that capture the AI-driven boom. The model matches the untargeted paths of imports, output, and inflation; we use it to decompose the effects of tariffs and the investment boom. Absent the investment boom, imports would have fallen by 10 percent and activity would have contracted by 0.7 percent. The effects of tariffs depend on which goods are tariffed: tariffs on consumption and intermediates act like shocks to supply; tariffs on capital goods act like shocks to demand. The concentration of the 2025 tariff increases on consumption goods and the relative sparing of capital goods limited the damage to output while amplifying the inflationary impulse.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2025年美国关税上升至大萧条以来最高水平但进口仍增加的现象（"贸易崩溃缺失"之谜）。作者构建了一个包含关税异质性、库存和投资冲击（AI驱动繁荣）的开放经济新凯恩斯模型，模型成功匹配了进口、产出和通胀的未设定目标路径，并用来分解关税和投资繁荣的效应。
AI.research_question: 为什么2025年美国关税升至大萧条以来最高水平，但进口不降反增？关税和AI驱动的投资繁荣各自对宏观经济产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 2025年美国关税大幅上升通常应导致进口锐减（贸易崩溃），但实际进口却增加了，这一"缺失的贸易崩溃"现象难以用传统贸易模型解释，需要新的理论框架来解释这一反常现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济新凯恩斯模型（Open-Economy New Keynesian Model），包含关税异质性、库存（inventories）以及投资冲击。
AI.method: 构建开放经济新凯恩斯模型（含关税异质性、库存、投资冲击），通过模型模拟匹配美国实际数据（进口、产出、通胀的未设定目标路径），并进行反事实分解以区分关税效应与投资繁荣效应。
AI.findings: （1）若无投资繁荣，进口将下降10%、经济活动收缩0.7%；（2）关税效应取决于被征税的商品类型：对消费品和中间品征税类似于供给冲击，对资本品征税类似于需求冲击；（3）2025年关税集中于消费品、相对豁免资本品，这一结构限制了产出的损害，但放大了通胀压力。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了关税异质性框架，区分了不同类型商品（消费品/中间品/资本品）关税的宏观经济传导机制差异（供给冲击vs需求冲击）；（2）将库存机制整合进开放经济新凯恩斯模型，为"贸易崩溃缺失"现象提供了理论解释；（3）证明了关税结构（而非仅关税水平）对宏观经济影响具有决定性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了关税结构设计的评估框架——不同类型的关税对产出和通胀的影响截然不同；（2）表明AI驱动的投资繁荣可以在一定程度上抵消关税的负面产出效应，但会放大通胀压力；（3）为理解当前美国宏观经济中贸易与通胀的互动关系提供了实证依据。

title: Selection into Medicine
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Health Care Management and Northwestern University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Selection into Medicine
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how selection into medicine in the United States influences physician practice styles. We exploit macroeconomic conditions at the time of medical school application as an exogenous shock to the applicant pool and find that labor market downturns in other prestigious fields increase applications to medical school and shift the composition of matriculating cohorts toward students from non–pre-medical backgrounds. Strikingly, these low–outside-option cohorts practice medicine differently decades later. Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用宏观经济条件作为外生冲击，研究美国医学生选拔如何影响医生执业风格。研究发现，其他高声望行业就业市场低迷时，医学申请人数增加，且录取群体中非医学背景学生比例上升。这些"低外部机会"群体的医生在数十年后表现出更强的财务动机驱动的执业行为——对每位受益人的医保账单更高（尤其是可自由裁量的创收服务），并倾向于选择高财务激励的执业环境，但额外支出并未改善患者健康。
AI.research_question: 美国医学选拔过程如何影响医生的执业风格？具体而言，医学生申请时面临的宏观经济条件是否通过改变录取群体的构成，进而影响其多年后作为医生的诊疗行为？
AI.motivation: 医生执业行为差异巨大，但对其来源的理解有限。传统观点认为医生培训和实践环境塑造执业风格，而本文质疑医学录取本身是否就存在筛选偏差——即进入医学的人选（而非其后的培训）是否已经决定了执业方式。理解这一机制对医学教育政策和医疗成本控制有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"外部机会"（outside options）与职业选择的理论框架，结合人力资本与内在/外在动机理论。核心假设是：当其他高薪领域就业前景不佳时，被"推入"医学的人往往更受财务动机驱动，而非内在的从医兴趣。
AI.method: 利用医科申请时点的宏观经济状况作为外生冲击（自然实验），对比"低外部机会"群体（经济衰退期入学）与"高外部机会"群体（经济繁荣期入学）医生在多年后的执业行为差异。使用Medicare数据，控制经验、专科、结果年份等变量进行回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）其他行业就业低迷增加医学申请人数，并改变录取群体的构成——非医学背景学生比例上升；（2）衰退期入学（低外部机会）的医生在多年后对每位受益人产生更高的Medicare账单，且更多来自可自由裁量的创收服务；（3）这些医生倾向于选择财务激励更强的执业环境（如私人执业而非学术机构）；（4）尽管支出更高，但未检测到患者健康结果的改善。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次证明职业选择的筛选效应具有长期持续性——入学时的动机结构会数十年后持续影响执业行为；（2）揭示医学录取对"执业风格相关属性"的筛选不完善，挑战了培训体系能"标准化"医生行为的隐含假设；（3）将外部宏观经济条件与个体内在动机联系起来，丰富了职业选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对医学录取政策提出警示：录取标准可能需注重筛选与财务动机相关的特质；（2）对Medicare等医保支付体系有政策含义——财务激励结构可能放大个体差异；（3）对医疗成本控制提供新视角：部分医疗支出差异可能源于医生的职业选择动机而非单纯的制度因素。

title: The Resolution Window: Retail Agreement and Stock Market Reactions to FDA Regulatory Decisions
affiliations: Arthur D. Little Inc. - Hult International Business School

detail.title: The Resolution Window: Retail Agreement and Stock Market Reactions to FDA Regulatory Decisions
detail.abstract: FDA decisions on new drug applications occur on a fixed date announced months in advance and end in one of two outcomes: approval or a Complete Response Letter. That interval is a bounded resolution window in which retail investors argue publicly about an outcome none of them controls, and about which neither the agency nor the sponsor may say much. This paper examines X/Twitter discourse ahead of 143 such decisions, classifying posts by topic and directional stance. First, Da, Engelberg, and Gao (2011) show that attention spikes predict a short-term price increase that partially reverses across the general cross-section of stocks; attention ahead of a scheduled FDA decision shows the same initial increase but no reversal, so what accumulates inside the window does not wash out. Second, greater agreement in pre-decision regulatory discourse predicts a smaller price reaction and lower realized volatility, controlling for market capitalization, prior Complete Response Letters, and decision timing. Agreement on clinical trial evidence predicts neither, so the effect is specific to the regulatory question, not agreement in general. Third, which way discourse leans, bullish or bearish, is associated with whether the decision ends in approval or a Complete Response Letter, though that association is fragile and, unlike the magnitude result, holds for clinical discourse as well. Agreement is therefore not one construct but two: its degree and its direction behave differently. Together the three results describe what fills an information vacuum that current disclosure policy is actively reshaping.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了FDA新药申请决策日前X/Twitter上的公开讨论，发现：注意力在固定决策窗口内积累的股价影响不会反转；事前监管话语的一致性（而非临床证据话语）与更小的股价反应和更低波动率相关；话语的看涨/看跌方向与最终审批结果存在脆弱关联。研究表明"一致性"包含程度与方向两个不同维度。
AI.research_question: 在FDA新药申请决策这一固定、有界的信息真空窗口内，社交媒体（X/Twitter）上的监管话语如何影响股票价格行为？话语的一致性程度与方向如何分别发挥作用？
AI.motivation: FDA对新药申请的决策日期提前数月公布，且结果仅为批准或完整回复函两种，这是一个有界的信息真空窗口——散户投资者在其中公开争论一个无人能控制的结果，而机构与申办方均不能多言。现有披露政策正在重塑这一信息真空，但对其中的公众话语动态及其市场影响缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力驱动交易理论（Da, Engelberg, and Gao 2011）；信息一致性/社会认同与市场反应的关联框架；话语方向（看涨/看跌）与结果预测的弱信号理论。
AI.method: 对143个FDA决策日前的X/Twitter帖子进行分类（按主题与方向性立场），结合股价反应与已实现波动率进行实证分析，控制市值、先前完整回复函及决策时点等变量。
AI.findings: （1）决策窗口前的注意力引发股价初期上涨但无反转，与一般横截面股票的表现不同；（2）事前监管话语（非临床证据话语）的一致性越高，股价反应越小、已实现波动率越低；（3）话语的看涨/看跌方向与最终批准或完整回复函结果存在脆弱关联，且该关联对临床话语同样成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"一致性"的两个独立维度——程度（magnitude）与方向（direction），二者对市场结果的影响机制不同；将注意力驱动的价格效应从一般横截面情境延伸到固定事件窗口情境，发现其反转模式差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管层理解FDA决策窗口期社交媒体信息真空的填充机制提供经验证据；为投资者解读FDA决策前的社交媒体信号提供参考，提示话语一致性程度与方向应区别对待。

title: Silence, Shame, and Screens: A Gendered Analysis of Online Harassment and Extortion Among Tunisian Adolescents
affiliations: United Nations - United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), affiliation not provided to SSRN and United Nations - United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF)

detail.title: Silence, Shame, and Screens: A Gendered Analysis of Online Harassment and Extortion Among Tunisian Adolescents
detail.abstract: Background: Online violence is a growing child-protection and gender-equality concern in the Middle East and North Africa, yet little is known about the mechanisms that make girls disproportionately vulnerable to online sexual harassment and extortion.Objectives: This study examines how gender norms shape adolescents' exposure to online harassment and image-based extortion, their disclosure decisions, and the institutional response they encounter, extending a companion study that first identified this gender disparity.Participants and setting: Focus groups with 113 adolescents (64 girls, 49 boys, aged 13-17), 28 parents, and 22 educators, and 17 key-stakeholder interviews with child-protection officers, judges, police, and civil society actors, conducted across five governorates in Tunisia in 2022.Methods: Reflexive thematic analysis (Braun & Clarke, 2006, 2019) was applied to three linked qualitative strands - adolescent, parent/educator, and key-stakeholder data - with themes developed and reviewed iteratively by a multi-disciplinary research team.Results: Four analytic themes were developed: perpetrators calibrate exploitation to gendered reputational stakes; shame operates as a social mechanism that actively suppresses disclosure; state protective institutions mirror rather than counteract the honour logic that silences girls at home; and individual and peer resistance narrows risk but cannot substitute for a functioning protective system.Conclusions: Online abuse against girls in this context is best understood as a gendered social problem sustained by intersecting family, institutional, and societal mechanisms, not simply a digital safety issue. Effective prevention requires legislative implementation, protection for mandatory reporters, and survivor-centred reporting pathways, alongside efforts to shift the gender norms that convert victimisation into family shame.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2022年在突尼斯五个省的定性研究（113名青少年、28名家长、22名教育工作者及17名关键利益相关者的访谈），探讨性别规范如何塑造中东和北非地区女孩在线上性骚扰和图像勒索中的脆弱性、披露决策及制度回应。研究发现四个核心主题：施暴者利用性别声誉风险进行剥削、羞耻感抑制披露、国家保护机构镜像而非对抗家庭中的荣誉逻辑、个人与同伴的抵抗只能缩小风险但无法替代有效的保护系统。论文结论认为，针对女孩的线上虐待是一个由家庭、制度和社会的交叉机制维持的性别化社会问题，而不仅仅是数字安全问题。
AI.research_question: 性别规范如何塑造中东和北非地区青少年女孩遭受线上骚扰和图像勒索的暴露程度、披露决策以及她们所遇到的制度回应？
AI.motivation: 线上暴力是中东和北非地区日益增长的儿童保护和性别平等问题，但关于使女孩不成比例地更容易遭受线上性骚扰和勒索的机制知之甚少。本研究旨在填补这一知识空白，扩展先前发现性别差异的配套研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于性别规范的视角，探讨性别规范如何塑造女孩在线上暴力中的脆弱性、披露和制度回应，涉及"荣誉逻辑"（honour logic）和"羞耻感作为社会机制"等核心概念。
AI.method: 采用反思性主题分析（Reflexive thematic analysis, Braun & Clarke 2006, 2019），对三组相互关联的定性数据进行分析：113名青少年（64名女孩、49名男孩，13-17岁）的焦点小组、28名家长和22名教育工作者、以及17名与儿童保护官员、法官、警察和民间社会行为者的关键利益相关者访谈。数据于2022年在突尼斯五个省收集，由多学科研究团队迭代开发和审查主题。
AI.findings: 研究开发了四个分析主题：（1）施暴者根据性别化的声誉风险调整剥削手段；（2）羞耻感作为社会机制主动抑制披露；（3）国家保护机构镜像而非对抗在家中使女孩沉默的荣誉逻辑；（4）个人和同伴的抵抗只能缩小风险，但无法替代有效的保护系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将针对女孩的线上虐待概念化为一个由家庭、制度和社会机制交叉维持的"性别化社会问题"，而不仅仅是数字安全问题，为理解线上性别暴力提供了超越技术安全视角的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究提出了具体预防措施：需要落实立法、为强制报告者提供保护、建立以幸存者为中心的举报途径，同时还需努力转变将受害转化为家庭耻辱的性别规范。

title: Group $\ell_0$-Penalized Variable Selection for Generalized Scalar-on-Function Models with Irregular Longitudinal Covariates
affiliations: Shanxi University of Finance and Economics, Shanxi University of Finance and Economics, Shanxi University of Finance and Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Group $\ell_0$-Penalized Variable Selection for Generalized Scalar-on-Function Models with Irregular Longitudinal Covariates
detail.abstract: In many biomedical and social science studies, covariates are repeatedly measured over a follow-up period, whereas the response is observed only once after all covariate measurements have been collected. Conventional generalized linear models are not designed to accommodate such longitudinal covariate trajectories or capture their historical effects on a scalar response. To address this limitation, we propose a generalized historical scalar-on-function modeling framework for irregularly observed longitudinal covariates with a static response.The coefficient functions are estimated using B-spline basis expansions, while variable selection is simultaneously performed through a group $\ell_0$ penalty. To efficiently solve the resulting optimization problem, we develop two algorithms: group iterative hard thresholding and feature selection with annealing.Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing competitors in variable selection, estimation accuracy, and prediction performance, particularly for regression models. Finally, we apply the proposed framework to data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study to identify longitudinal risk factors for depression and diabetes. The real-data analysis demonstrates the practical utility and interpretability of the proposed methods for identifying important disease-associated covariates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义历史标量-函数回归建模框架，用于处理不规则观测的纵向协变量轨迹对静态响应的历史效应。通过B样条基展开估计系数函数，并采用组ℓ0惩罚进行变量选择，开发了两种高效算法（分组迭代硬阈值和退火特征选择）。模拟研究和中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）数据的实证分析验证了该方法在变量选择、估计精度和预测性能上的优越性。
AI.research_question: 如何处理纵向重复测量的协变量轨迹对单一标量响应的历史效应，并在估计系数函数的同时实现有效的变量选择？
AI.motivation: 传统广义线性模型无法适应纵向协变量轨迹的建模，也无法捕捉这些协变量的历史效应对标量响应的影响，需要一种新的建模框架来解决这一局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标量-函数回归模型（scalar-on-function regression）、广义线性模型、B样条基展开、组ℓ0惩罚
AI.method: 提出广义历史标量-函数回归框架，系数函数通过B样条基展开估计，变量选择采用组ℓ0惩罚；开发了两种优化算法：分组迭代硬阈值（group iterative hard thresholding）和退火特征选择（feature selection with annealing）。
AI.findings: 模拟研究表明所提方法在变量选择、估计精度和预测性能上均一致优于现有竞争方法，尤其在回归模型中表现突出；基于CHARLS数据的实证分析成功识别了与抑郁和糖尿病相关的纵向风险因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了标量-函数回归理论框架，使其能够处理不规则观测的纵向协变量数据并捕捉历史效应；将组ℓ0惩罚引入该框架实现同时系数估计与变量选择；提出了两种新的高效优化算法解决非凸优化问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生物医学和社会科学领域的研究者提供了一种实用的建模工具，可从纵向随访数据中识别疾病相关的风险因素，并在中国健康与养老追踪研究数据中成功应用于抑郁和糖尿病的风险因素识别。

title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
affiliations: University of Michigan, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), University of Virginia and The University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
detail.abstract:
Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment—that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在德克萨斯州达拉斯县对645户家庭进行实地实验，检验AI税务聊天机器人对房产税上诉行为的影响。结果显示，AI聊天机器人的使用显著提高了家庭提交上诉的可能性（从41.4%提高到50.5%），但这一效果在弱势家庭中较小，暗示AI可能扩大了现有的不平等。
AI.research_question: 纳税人如何使用AI税务代理？这些工具如何影响纳税人的行为？
AI.motivation: 纳税系统需要纳税人具备信息和判断力，而这些往往是纳税人所缺乏的。虽然纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但AI可能以更低的成本提供类似的帮助。然而，缺乏关于纳税人如何使用AI税务代理及其行为影响的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称和纳税人行为决策理论，探讨AI工具如何弥补纳税人的信息与判断力缺口。
AI.method: 实地实验（field experiment），涉及645户家庭随机分组。所有家庭都获得提供个性化信息、申请说明和支持性证据的网站，其中一半家庭额外获得AI聊天机器人功能。使用点击流数据和对话记录进行分析。
AI.findings: 78%的家庭发起了与聊天机器人的对话；AI聊天机器人使无人工代理提交上诉的概率提高了9.1个百分点（从41.4%提高到50.5%）；点击流和对话记录表明聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力；弱势家庭中上诉提交的增加幅度较小，提示聊天机器人可能扩大了现有的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI工具如何影响纳税人行为提供了首个因果证据，揭示了AI辅助决策中"使用者特征"如何调节技术效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了AI税务援助的潜力，同时提醒政策制定者注意AI使用效果的异质性，即受益者取决于纳税人如何使用技术而不仅仅是能否访问技术。

title: Risk Mitigation Versus Gains Maximisation – The Two Logics of Smaller Power Hedging Amid Intensifying Great Power Rivalry
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: Risk Mitigation Versus Gains Maximisation – The Two Logics of Smaller Power Hedging Amid Intensifying Great Power Rivalry
detail.abstract: How can smaller powers use hedging effectively to navigate the intensifying great power rivalry? Why can some smaller powers hedge successfully between competing great powers while others fail and suffer serious harm? The burgeoning hedging literature is largely silent about which hedging patterns are likely to be more successful and why. This research contributes to the field by discerning and specifying two distinct modes of hedging – “risk mitigation” and “gains maximisation” – and their implications for hedging outcomes under intensifying great power rivalry. It argues that while these two modes might seem similar, and the extant literature has so far failed to separate them, primarily conceiving hedging as risk minimisation, they have different operational logics and are likely to have different consequences for the hedging states. It probes the two concepts using cases of smaller power hedging in Southeast Asia (Malaysia and Vietnam), exposed to the China–US rivalry, and in the post-Soviet space (Georgia and Ukraine), exposed to the Russia–North Atlantic Treaty Organization rivalry. It further argues that as great power rivalry intensifies, abandoning the gains maximisation and consolidating the risk-mitigation logic of hedging can help mitigate threats posed by great powers and minimise the chances of hedging failure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨小国在中美、俄北约等大国竞争加剧背景下如何有效使用对冲策略，区分了"风险缓解"和"收益最大化"两种对冲模式，并通过东南亚（马来西亚、越南）和后苏联空间（格鲁吉亚、乌克兰）的案例验证，认为随着大国竞争加剧，从收益最大化转向风险缓解逻辑有助于降低对冲失败风险。
AI.research_question: 小国如何有效使用对冲策略来应对日益加剧的大国竞争？为什么有些小国能成功对冲而另一些则失败并遭受严重损害？
AI.motivation: 现有对冲文献大量关注对冲的定义与类型，但很少探讨哪些对冲模式更可能成功以及为什么。文献大多将对冲视为风险最小化，未能区分不同对冲模式之间的差异及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对冲理论（hedging theory），提出两种对冲模式："风险缓解"（risk mitigation）和"收益最大化"（gains maximisation），二者具有不同的运营逻辑和后果。
AI.method: 概念辨析与比较案例分析：选取东南亚的马来西亚和越南（面对中美竞争）以及后苏联空间的格鲁吉亚和乌克兰（面对俄北约竞争）作为小国对冲的案例进行检验。
AI.findings: 两种对冲模式看似相似但运营逻辑不同且后果不同；随着大国竞争加剧，放弃收益最大化逻辑并巩固风险缓解逻辑有助于缓解大国威胁并最小化对冲失败的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了两种对冲模式——风险缓解与收益最大化，填补了文献中对对冲模式成功率差异讨论的空白，丰富了小国外交战略理论中关于对冲结果的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小国决策者提供了在不同大国竞争环境下选择对冲策略的操作性指导，特别是在竞争加剧时应如何调整对冲逻辑以降低风险。

title: Indications, Procedural Standards, and Training Requirements for Flexible Nasolaryngoscopy in Pulmonology – a Delphi study protocol
affiliations: Monash Health, Monash University and Monash Health

detail.title: Indications, Procedural Standards, and Training Requirements for Flexible Nasolaryngoscopy in Pulmonology – a Delphi study protocol
detail.abstract: Flexible nasolaryngoscopy (FNL) is a well-established, minimally invasive procedure for assessing the nasal passages, nasopharynx, and larynx. Its role in pulmonology is expanding, particularly for evaluating vocal cord dysfunction/inducible laryngeal obstruction, chronic cough, and other upper airway conditions relevant to the “united airways” model of care. However, no consensus-based guidance currently exists on the indications, procedural standards, or training requirements for FNL performed by pulmonologists. This protocol describes a modified two-round Delphi study that will survey an international, purposively sampled panel of pulmonologists and otolaryngologists via an online platform hosted by Monash University, using a five-point Likert scale and pre-specified consensus thresholds (≥70% agreement). Findings will be validated through a structured expert roundtable.• Establishes expert consensus on clinical indications and contraindications for FNL in pulmonology practice.• Develops consensus on procedural standards, curriculum, and competency requirements for FNL training in pulmonology.• Identifies priority areas for future research to support integration of FNL into pulmonology services.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一项改良两轮德尔菲研究的方案，旨在就肺科医生进行柔性鼻咽喉镜检查（FNL）的适应证、操作标准及培训要求达成专家共识，填补该领域缺乏循证指南的空白。
AI.research_question: 肺科医生实施柔性鼻咽喉镜检查（FNL）的适应证、操作标准及培训要求应如何达成专家共识？
AI.motivation: FNL在肺科领域的应用日益扩展（如声带功能障碍、慢性咳嗽等），但目前缺乏基于共识的指南来规范肺科医生的FNL适应证、操作标准及培训要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 德尔菲共识方法（改良两轮）；"联合气道"（united airways）照护模型
AI.method: 采用改良两轮德尔菲研究，通过Monash大学在线平台对国际肺科和耳鼻喉科专家进行目的性抽样调查，使用五点李克特量表，共识阈值预设为≥70%同意率，并通过结构化专家圆桌会议进行验证。
AI.findings: 该研究为方案论文，尚未报告最终结果。预期产出包括：FNL在肺科实践中的临床适应证与禁忌证共识、操作标准/课程/能力要求共识、以及未来研究优先领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为肺科领域的FNL应用建立了基于共识的规范化框架，弥合了肺科与耳鼻喉科之间的学科交叉空白，推动"联合气道"模型下的循证实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肺科医生提供FNL操作的标准化指南和培训要求，有助于提升肺科服务质量、规范临床操作流程，并为未来研究指明方向。

title: Job displacement and the health of older adults: Evidence from China
affiliations: Zhejiang Gongshang University and Guangdong University of Technology

detail.title: Job displacement and the health of older adults: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the long-term consequences of involuntary job displacement on multidimensional health outcomes among middle-aged and older adults in urban China, using the 2014 China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Survey (CHARLS) Life History Questionnaire. To address the endogeneity of job loss, we exploit business closures, position cancellations, and layoffs during the state-owned enterprises (SOEs) reforms in the late 1990s as exogenous labor market shocks and employ Propensity Score Matching (PSM) to control for childhood socioeconomic conditions and family health history. The results show that the overall health of displaced workers has deteriorated in the long run, particularly in terms of mental well-being and cognitive functioning. The adverse effects are more pronounced among males, younger cohorts, and highly educated individuals. Further analysis suggests that these effects operate through increased financial constraints, reduced healthcare utilization, and disrupted social integration.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2014年中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）生命历程问卷，以1990年代末国有企业改革造成的事业冲击为外生变量，考察非自愿失业对中国城市中老年人多维健康结果的长期影响。研究发现，失业工人的整体健康在长期内恶化，尤其是心理健康和认知功能方面，且负面影响在男性、较年轻群体和高学历人群中更为显著。机制分析表明，负面效应通过财务约束增加、医疗利用减少和社会融入受阻等渠道发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 非自愿事业对中国城市中老年人的多维健康结果（身体、心理、认知等）产生何种长期影响？这些影响在不同群体间是否存在异质性，其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 事业冲击的长期健康后果是劳动经济学和健康经济学的重要议题，但现有研究多关注短期效应或单一健康维度，缺乏对多维健康长期后果的系统考察，尤其是针对中国国有企业改革这一大规模失业事件的证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事业冲击的长期健康理论，涵盖经济压力模型（财务约束对健康的制约）、健康资本积累理论（失业导致的收入减少影响健康投资）、社会融合理论（失业破坏社会网络和社会支持）等。
AI.method: 利用1990年代末国有企业改革导致的企业倒闭、岗位取消和裁员作为外生劳动力市场冲击，以解决事业内生性问题；采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）方法控制童年社会经济状况和家族健康史等混杂因素。
AI.findings: 非自愿失业者的整体健康在长期内恶化，尤其是心理健康和认知功能受损明显；负面影响在男性、较年轻群体和高学历个体中更为突出；机制上，负面效应通过增加财务约束、减少医疗保健利用和破坏社会融入而发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了事业长期健康后果的研究视角，从单一维度扩展到多维健康结果；为失业健康影响的理论框架提供了来自中国情境的经验证据，验证了经济压力和社会融合等传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对失业人群（尤其是男性、年轻和高学历群体）的长期健康干预依据，有助于设计针对性的社会保障和心理健康支持政策。

title: Contraceptive Methods and Anemia in India: A Cost-Benefit Simulation of Hormonal IUD Provision
affiliations: and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: Contraceptive Methods and Anemia in India: A Cost-Benefit Simulation of Hormonal IUD Provision

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of de-identified data from the 2019–21 National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5). Ethical approval for NFHS-5 was obtained from the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) and the ICF Institutional Review Board, and informed consent was obtained from all participants. No additional ethics approval was required for this secondary analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding.

detail.abstract: Anemia affects more than half of women of reproductive age in India. Copper intrauterine devices (IUDs) dominate public-sector IUD provision and can increase menstrual blood loss, whereas hormonal methods reduce it; however, family planning and anemia-control programs typically operate separately. Using cross-sectional data from 294,606 married, nonpregnant women aged 15-49 in India's 2019-21 National Family Health Survey, we estimated adjusted associations between contraceptive method use and hemoglobin using debiased machine learning to flexibly adjust for high-dimensional measured confounding. We also compared current with former users within each method type. We then used the adjusted association in a cost-benefit simulation of providing hormonal IUDs to current users in the predominantly copper reported-IUD group who screen positive for anemia. In the adjusted contrast, hormonal contraception rather than reported-IUD use was associated with 0.143 g/dL higher hemoglobin (95% CI, 0.077-0.209). If this association is causal and the simulation assumptions hold, an any-anemia screening threshold is projected to avert 35,674 disability-adjusted life years over three years and yield a benefit-cost ratio of 2.55. Restricting eligibility to users who screen positive for moderate or severe anemia yields a projected ratio of 3.28 while retaining 77% of projected health gains. For the any-anemia strategy, benefit-cost ratios range from 1.70 to 2.55 across the main specification and parameter sensitivity scenarios. These projections motivate a pragmatic trial of voluntary hemoglobin screening and expanded access to hormonal IUDs within family planning services.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度2019-21年全国家庭健康调查的294,606名育龄妇女横断面数据，通过去偏机器学习方法发现激素类避孕相较铜宫内节育器（IUD）与更高血红蛋白水平（高0.143 g/dL）相关。基于该关联的成本效益模拟显示，在贫血筛查后为铜IUD使用者提供激素IUD，三年内可避免35,674个伤残调整生命年（DALY），效益成本比最高达2.55（重度贫血策略达3.28），为在计划生育服务中整合贫血筛查和激素IUD推广提供了依据。
AI.research_question: 激素类避孕方法（相比铜IUD）是否与更高的血红蛋白水平相关，以及将激素IUD提供给贫血筛查阳性的铜IUD使用者是否具有成本效益？
AI.motivation: 印度超过一半育龄妇女患有贫血，而铜IUD（公共部门主流避孕方法）会增加月经失血量，激素类避孕则能减少失血；但计划生育和贫血控制项目通常分开运作，缺乏将二者整合的量化证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 避孕方法通过影响月经失血量进而影响血红蛋白水平与贫血风险；基于此生理机制构建避孕方式-贫血关联分析框架，并纳入成本效益分析。
AI.method: 基于印度2019-21年NFHS调查数据（294,606名已婚非孕期15-49岁女性），使用去偏机器学习（debiased machine learning）灵活调整高维混杂因素，估计避孕方法使用与血红蛋白的调整关联；比较同一方法类型内当前与既往使用者；基于调整关联进行成本效益模拟，比较不同贫血筛查阈值策略。
AI.findings: 激素类避孕相较铜IUD使用与0.143 g/dL更高的血红蛋白相关（95%CI: 0.077-0.209）。若关联为因果且模拟假设成立，任何贫血筛查阈值下三年可避免35,674个DALY，效益成本比为2.55；限制为中重度贫血可达到3.28的效益成本比且保留77%的健康收益；主要规格和敏感性分析下效益成本比范围为1.70-2.55。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在高维混杂调整框架下量化激素避孕与铜IUD在血红蛋白水平上的差异关联，为'避孕方式影响贫血'的机制提供了基于大规模全国代表性数据的人群证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在计划生育服务中整合血红蛋白筛查和激素IUD可及性扩展提供了成本效益证据，支持开展自愿血红蛋白筛查和扩大激素IUD获取的务实试验，促进了计划生育与贫血控制项目的协同整合。

title: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in marine fish and sediment of the Musa Estuary, Persian Gulf: towards a human and ecotoxicological risk assessment
affiliations: Khorramshahr University of Marine Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Khorramshahr University of Marine Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Abadan University of Medical Sciences

detail.title: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in marine fish and sediment of the Musa Estuary, Persian Gulf: towards a human and ecotoxicological risk assessment
detail.abstract: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) pose persistent ecological and human-health concerns in industrialized coastal systems. This study assessed the 16 USEPA priority PAHs in surface sediments and muscle tissue of four commercially important fish species from five stations across the Musa Estuary, Persian Gulf, during summer and winter 2023. Total Σ16PAH concentrations in sediments were significantly higher in summer than winter (365 ± 27 vs. 250 ± 42 ng g⁻¹ dw; p = 0.008). Fish ΣBaPeq ranged from 5.4 to 12.5 ng g⁻¹ ww across stations and was higher in summer than winter (12.6 ± 4.9 vs. 7.6 ± 7.7 ng g⁻¹ ww). PAH composition also shifted seasonally, from greater contributions of 2- and 6-ring compounds in summer toward 3–4-ring compounds in winter. Elevated BSAFs for high-molecular-weight PAHs in benthic species were consistent with an additional contribution from dietary exposure. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) resolved four source classes: petrogenic, coal combustion, traffic emissions, and high-temperature combustion, with petrogenic inputs dominating summer profiles and coal combustion becoming more prominent in winter. Monte Carlo probabilistic assessment (10,000 iterations) yielded a mean adult incremental lifetime cancer risk (ILCR) of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵, with approximately 77% of simulations exceeding 10⁻⁵. Petrogenic sources accounted for an estimated 65.6% of source-attributed cancer risk. These findings demonstrate pronounced seasonal variation in PAH contamination and identify petroleum-related inputs as an important priority for pollution-management strategies in the Musa Estuary.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了波斯湾穆萨河口表层沉积物和四种商业鱼类肌肉组织中16种USEPA优先多环芳烃（PAHs）的季节性分布。研究发现夏季PAH浓度显著高于冬季，沉积物中Σ16PAH夏季为365±27 ng/g dw，冬季为250±42 ng/g dw。通过NMF源解析识别出石油源、燃煤、交通排放和高温燃烧四类来源，其中石油源在夏季占主导。蒙特卡洛风险评估显示成人平均增量终身癌症风险（ILCR）为3.5×10⁻⁵，约77%的模拟结果超过10⁻⁵，其中石油源贡献了65.6%的源归因癌症风险。
AI.research_question: 穆萨河口表层沉积物和商业鱼类中PAHs的季节性污染特征、来源解析及人体健康风险如何？
AI.motivation: 多环芳烃（PAHs）在工业化沿海系统中构成持续性的生态和人类健康威胁，需要全面评估其在穆萨河口这一受工业化影响的区域中的污染水平、季节变化、来源及健康风险，为污染管理策略提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: PAHs优先污染物评估框架；非负矩阵分解（NMF）源解析模型；生物-沉积物累积因子（BSAF）；蒙特卡洛概率风险评估方法；增量终身癌症风险（ILCR）模型
AI.method: 在穆萨河口5个站点于2023年夏季和冬季采集表层沉积物及4种商业鱼类肌肉组织样本，测定16种USEPA优先PAHs浓度；使用NMF解析污染来源；计算BSAF评估生物累积特征；采用蒙特卡洛模拟（10,000次迭代）进行概率健康风险评估。
AI.findings: （1）沉积物Σ16PAH夏季显著高于冬季（365±27 vs. 250±42 ng/g dw；p=0.008）；（2）鱼类ΣBaPeq夏季高于冬季（12.6±4.9 vs. 7.6±7.7 ng/g ww）；（3）PAH组成呈现季节性迁移：夏季以2环和6环为主，冬季以3–4环为主；（4）底栖鱼类中高分子量PAHs的BSAF升高，表明存在饮食暴露的额外贡献；（5）NMF解析出石油源、燃煤、交通排放和高温燃烧四类来源，石油源主导夏季，燃煤在冬季更突出；（6）蒙特卡洛评估显示成人平均ILCR为3.5×10⁻⁵，77%模拟超过10⁻⁵，石油源贡献65.6%的源归因癌症风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将NMF源解析与蒙特卡洛概率风险评估相结合，系统揭示了亚热带河口PAHs的季节性源-汇动态及其健康风险归因，为理解工业化沿海系统中PAHs的季节性驱动机制提供了新证据，尤其是在区分不同来源对癌症风险的贡献比例方面具有方法学意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明穆萨河口PAH污染存在显著季节性差异，石油相关输入是污染管理的关键优先方向（贡献65.6%的癌症风险）。为当地环境监管部门提供了季节差异化的污染管控策略依据，建议优先针对石油来源（如航运、石油开采、泄漏等）实施管控措施。

title: Price Formation and Information Flow in Earnings Prediction Markets
affiliations: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers Business School at Newark & New Brunswick and

detail.title: Price Formation and Information Flow in Earnings Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: We study the price dynamics of prediction market contracts tied to quarterly corporate earnings. Using a sample of 599 Polymarket earnings events, we combine trade-level Polymarket prices with high-frequency stock prices, analyst forecasts, and firm news to examine how prices react to information. We first document that a large share of price adjustment occurs immediately after markets open despite limited trading activity, and early prices strongly extrapolate from firms' past earnings-beat histories. Second, Polymarket prices have a strong reversal effect that varies with lookback window and forecast horizon. Third, stock returns positively predict subsequent Polymarket price changes over the subsequent one hour to one day, and the predictive relation becomes more pronounced as the earnings announcement approaches. In contrast, Polymarket price changes do not predict stock returns, consistent with a one-way information flow from the stock market to Polymarket. In addition, Polymarket prices respond to analyst forecast revisions in the direction of consensus change without subsequent reversal, but react only temporarily to news sentiment. Lastly, we find that the arrival of firm news strengthens the predictive relation between stock returns and future Polymarket price changes, supporting a potential attention channel in the information flow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了与季度公司盈利挂钩的预测市场合约的价格动态。利用599个Polymarket盈利事件，结合交易级价格、高频股价、分析师预测和公司新闻，发现：价格调整在开盘后立即大规模发生且早期价格强外推历史盈利超预期记录；Polymarket价格存在随回看窗口和预测期限变化的强反转效应；股票收益能正向预测后续Polymarket价格变化（临近公告时更显著），但反向不成立，体现股市到预测市场的单向信息流；价格对分析师预测修正有持续性反应但对新闻情绪只有暂时性反应；公司新闻到达会强化股票收益对Polymarket价格变化的预测关系，支持注意力渠道。
AI.research_question: 预测市场合约（Polymarket）的价格如何对信息做出反应？其价格动态的决定因素是什么？股票市场与预测市场之间的信息流向如何？
AI.motivation: 预测市场日益普及，但其价格形成机制尚不清晰。以往研究多关注选举等长期事件，本文首次系统研究与企业盈利这种高频、可量化事件挂钩的预测市场合约，揭示其价格动态特征及与股票市场的信息流动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息扩散理论、市场微观结构理论、行为金融中的外推偏差与反转效应、注意力渠道理论。
AI.method: 使用599个Polymarket盈利事件，整合交易级Polymarket价格、高频股票价格、分析师预测及公司新闻数据，采用实证回归分析方法考察价格对信息的反应模式、价格反转效应、跨市场预测关系及信息流方向。
AI.findings: 1) 大部分价格调整在市场开盘后立即发生，尽管交易活动有限，且早期价格强外推公司过往盈利超预期历史；2) Polymarket价格存在强反转效应，且随回看窗口和预测期限变化；3) 股票收益正向预测后续Polymarket价格变化（1小时至1天），临近公告日预测力增强，反向预测不成立，体现单向信息流；4) 价格对分析师预测修正方向有持续反应无反转，但对新闻情绪仅暂时反应；5) 公司新闻到达强化股票收益与Polymarket价格变化间的预测关系，支持注意力渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画企业盈利相关预测市场的价格动态特征；揭示预测市场与股票市场间的单向信息流方向；识别外推偏差、反转效应和注意力渠道在预测市场定价中的作用，丰富了预测市场定价效率与信息传播理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场参与者提供价格动态规律和反转效应的实操参考；为监管者和市场设计者理解预测市场价格形成机制提供证据；为投资者利用股票市场信息预测预测市场价格提供策略启示。

title: Banks’ funding structures and pass-through in the euro area
affiliations: University College London - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Banks’ funding structures and pass-through in the euro area
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the interest rate pass-through of monetary policy in the euro area by focusing on the role of banks’ funding structures. We estimate the interest rate pass-through for loans to non-financial corporations using bank-level balance sheet data. In doing so, we interact the response of lending rates with characteristics of the funding structure, and show that banks that rely more on bond issuance than on the money market tend to be less responsive to policy changes. Finally, we test the presence of the asset-liability-management channel, and find that banks combining longer-term liabilities (higher bond shares) with longer rate fixation periods for loans (higher share of loans with fixed rates) exhibit the most muted lending rate response to policy shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧元区货币政策利率传导过程，聚焦银行融资结构的作用。通过使用银行层面的资产负债表数据估算对非金融企业贷款的利率传导，发现更依赖债券发行而非货币市场的银行对政策变化的反应较弱，并验证了资产负债管理渠道的存在。
AI.research_question: 银行融资结构如何影响欧元区货币政策对贷款利率的传导效果？资产负债管理渠道是否在其中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策利率传导的不完全性及其微观机制，特别是银行融资结构（债券发行vs货币市场依赖）在传导过程中的差异化作用，有助于深入认识货币政策有效性的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率传导机制理论、资产负债管理（ALM）渠道理论
AI.method: 利用银行层面资产负债表数据，通过将贷款利率对政策变化的响应与融资结构特征进行交互回归，估计不同融资结构银行的利率传导差异，并检验资产负债管理渠道。
AI.findings: （1）更依赖债券发行而非货币市场的银行，其贷款利率对政策变化的响应较弱；（2）兼具较长负债期限（较高债券份额）与较长贷款利率重定价期限（较高固定利率贷款份额）的银行，其贷款利率对政策冲击的反应最为迟钝，证实了资产负债管理渠道的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从银行融资结构视角系统刻画欧元区利率传导的异质性，并实证验证了资产负债管理渠道作为利率传导摩擦的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者评估欧元区不同银行体系下的政策传导效率提供实证依据，有助于理解债券市场深度对货币政策有效性（货币市场依赖度不足）的影响。

title: "Micro-Determinants of Retail IPO Participation in Emerging Markets: A Behavioral Analysis of the South Gujarat Economic Cluster"

detail.title: "Micro-Determinants of Retail IPO Participation in Emerging Markets: A Behavioral Analysis of the South Gujarat Economic Cluster"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves non-invasive survey-based data collection from individual retail investors. Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to survey completion, ensuring anonymity, voluntary participation, and confidentiality of responses. The research protocol adhered to standard institutional ethical guidelines for human participant research in business and social sciences.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or funding from public, commercial, or non-profit funding agencies.

detail.abstract: Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) are critical catalysts for capital mobilization and structural equity growth in emerging markets, yet retail investor engagement remains highly stratified. This study investigates the behavioral, cognitive, and demographic micro-determinants of IPO participation among retail investors in the South Gujarat region-a primary industrial and commercial hub in India. Utilizing a primary dataset of 485 retail investors collected via a stratified random sampling design across urban and suburban agglomerations (2024-2025), we deploy structural equation modeling (SEM) and multivariate logistic regression to isolate participation dynamics. The empirical results demonstrate that risk perception operates as the primary inhibitor of market entry (𝛽 =-0.412, 𝑝 < .001), decreasing the likelihood of participation by 33.7% for each unit increase on the psychometric risk scale. Conversely, financial literacy exerts a major positive influence (𝛽 = +0.487, 𝑝 < .001), rendering highly literate individuals 1.63 times more likely to execute IPO investments. Information source credibility and behavioral path-dependency (prior experience) further amplify participation probabilities. The integrated behavioral framework accounts for 61.4% of the variance in participation (𝑅 2 = 0.614), offering significant improvements over traditional single-theory cross-sectional frameworks. These insights provide stock exchanges, financial technology platforms, and regulatory authorities with a clear empirical framework for designing riskmitigating disclosure systems and targeted investor education programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于印度南古吉拉特地区485名散户投资者的原始调查数据（2024-2025年），运用结构方程模型（SEM）和多元逻辑回归，考察了IPO参与的行为、认知和人口统计学微观决定因素。研究发现风险感知是市场进入的主要抑制因素（β=-0.412），金融素养是最强的正向驱动因素（β=+0.487），综合模型解释了61.4%的参与方差。
AI.research_question: 在印度南古吉拉特地区，影响散户投资者参与IPO的行为、认知和人口统计学微观决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: IPO是新兴市场资本动员和股权结构增长的关键催化剂，但散户投资者的参与度存在高度分层现象。现有研究多采用单一理论横截面框架，缺乏对IPO参与微观决定因素的综合考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合行为框架，包含风险感知（行为因素）、金融素养（认知因素）、人口统计学特征以及信息来源可信度和行为路径依赖（先前经验）等维度。
AI.method: 采用分层随机抽样设计，收集485名散户投资者数据（2024-2025年），运用结构方程模型（SEM）和多元逻辑回归分析参与动态。
AI.findings: 1. 风险感知是市场进入的主要抑制因素（β=-0.412，p<.001），风险量表每增加一个单位，参与可能性降低33.7%；2. 金融素养是主要正向影响因素（β=+0.487，p<.001），高金融素养投资者参与IPO投资的可能性是低素养者的1.63倍；3. 信息来源可信度和行为路径依赖（先前经验）进一步放大参与概率；4. 综合模型解释了61.4%的参与方差（R²=0.614）。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合行为框架相比传统单一理论横截面框架有显著改进，为IPO参与研究提供了更全面的理论解释模型，贡献了多维度微观决定因素的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为证券交易所、金融科技平台和监管机构提供了清晰的实证框架，可用于设计风险缓释披露系统和针对性投资者教育项目。

title: The TANKFULL Model: Distributionally Weighted Investment and the Limits of Two-Type Aggregation

detail.title: The TANKFULL Model: Distributionally Weighted Investment and the Limits of Two-Type Aggregation
detail.abstract: Two-Agent New Keynesian (TANK) models provide a tractable middle ground between representative-agent New Keynesian models, which suppress household heterogeneity, and heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian (HANK) models, which retain rich household distributions at substantially greater analytical and computational cost. TANK models preserve economically important differences between two household types and can reproduce important aggregate implications of richer heterogeneous-household economies. Their very tractability, however, creates a potential limitation: compressing household heterogeneity to two types may discard distributional information that matters for productive investment. I develop the TANKFULL model to determine exactly how much investment-relevant distributional information a two-type New Keynesian model can preserve. I incorporate distributionally weighted investment, under which equal units of income received by different household groups can generate different marginal effects on productive investment because the groups differ in expenditure responses, expenditure incidence, and exposure to firms with different investment responsiveness. I establish both a positive result and a sharp dimensional limit. Two household types are sufficient for distribution to affect investment: an income-preserving reallocation changes investment whenever the types have different residual investment weights. But when their conventional marginal propensities to consume differ, aggregate disposable income and aggregate consumption jointly span the two-dimensional household-income space, leaving no independent residual income-distribution direction. I show that at least three independent household-income dimensions are generically required for a redistribution to leave both aggregate disposable income and aggregate consumption unchanged while still altering investment. More generally, when K locally independent aggregate statistics summarize an N-dimensional heterogeneous state, the residual state space has dimension N-K. TANKFULL therefore identifies both the additional distributional content available within the tractable TANK model and the precise dimensional boundary beyond which richer household heterogeneity becomes necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了TANKFULL模型，研究两类型新凯恩斯（TANK）模型能保留多少与生产性投资相关的分配信息。研究发现两个家庭类型足以使分配影响投资，但当边际消费倾向不同时，可保留的独立分配维度存在明确上限，至少需要三个独立的家庭收入维度才能同时保持总可支配收入和总消费不变而仍改变投资。
AI.research_question: 两类型新凯恩斯（TANK）模型能够保留多少与生产性投资相关的分配信息？其维度边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: TANK模型在代表性主体NK模型（抑制家庭异质性）和HANK模型（保留丰富家庭分布但计算成本高）之间提供了易处理的中间地带，但将家庭异质性压缩为两种类型可能丢弃对生产性投资重要的分配信息。作者希望精确确定这种信息损失的程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两主体新凯恩斯（TANK）模型、分配加权投资、家庭异质性维度分析
AI.method: 通过构建TANKFULL模型，引入分配加权投资概念（不同家庭群体的等量收入对生产性投资产生不同的边际效应），进行理论推导和维度分析，包括正结果和维度极限分析。
AI.findings: （1）两个家庭类型足以使分配影响投资：只要类型具有不同的残差投资权重，收入保持型再分配就会改变投资。（2）当常规边际消费倾向不同时，总可支配收入和总消费共同张成二维家庭收入空间，没有独立的残差收入分配方向。（3）至少需要三个独立的家庭收入维度才能同时保持总可支配收入和总消费不变而仍改变投资。（4）一般化地，当K个局部独立的加总统计量概括N维异质性状态时，残差状态空间维度为N-K。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次精确刻画了TANK模型在保留投资相关分配信息方面的能力边界；（2）建立了从TANK到HANK过渡的维度性判断标准；（3）推广了分配信息维度的一般性定理（N维状态与K个加总统计量的残差维度关系）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者选择TANK还是HANK模型提供了清晰的判断准则：当需要同时保持总消费和总投资对再分配不敏感时，两类型模型不够，需要更丰富的异质性建模。

title: Hidden in the aggregate: the cyclicality of EU labour force participation
affiliations: and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Hidden in the aggregate: the cyclicality of EU labour force participation
detail.abstract: We estimate the cyclical response of labour force participation to growth shocks across EU regions. We use a shift-share instrumental variable approach and local projections on EU Labour Force Survey microdata covering 15 countries and 114 regions over 2000–2020. The aggregate labour force participation rate is remarkably resilient, a clear contrast to the highly cyclical participation rate documented for the U.S. However, this resilience masks pronounced demographic heterogeneity. Men’s participation declines significantly while women’s remains stable, reflecting sectoral segregation and the added worker effect. Young workers exhibit the most persistent responses, with effects lasting up to eight years, consistent with hysteresis through human capital erosion. Less-educated and non-native workers bear disproportionate employment costs. The findings imply that aggregate slack measures may miss important distributional dimensions relevant for monetary, fiscal, and structural policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧盟劳动力调查微观数据（涵盖15个国家、114个地区，2000-2020年），采用shift-share工具变量法和局部投影方法，估计欧盟各地区劳动力参与率对增长冲击的周期性反应。研究发现：总体劳动力参与率高度韧性（与美国形成鲜明对比），但掩盖了显著的群体异质性——男性参与率显著下降而女性保持稳定，年轻工人反应最持久（影响持续长达8年），低教育程度和非本地工人承受不成比例的就业成本。
AI.research_question: 欧盟各地区劳动力参与率对增长冲击的周期性反应如何？这种反应在不同人口群体之间存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 美国劳动力参与率表现出高度周期性，但欧盟的情况尚不明晰。理解欧盟劳动力参与率的周期行为对货币政策、财政政策和结构性政策具有重要意义，特别是总需求不足时，劳动力退出（隐藏失业）可能使总产出缺口指标误导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力参与率的周期性行为理论、行业隔离理论（sectoral segregation）、附加工人效应（added worker effect）、人力资本侵蚀导致的滞后效应（hysteresis）理论。
AI.method: 利用欧盟劳动力调查（EU-LFS）微观数据，覆盖15个国家、114个地区，时间跨度为2000-2020年。采用shift-share（份额转移）工具变量方法来识别增长冲击造成的因果效应，并使用局部投影（local projections）方法估计动态脉冲响应。
AI.findings: （1）欧盟总体劳动力参与率对增长冲击表现出显著韧性，这与美国的高度周期性形成鲜明对比；（2）这种韧性掩盖了显著的人口学异质性：男性参与率显著下降而女性保持稳定，反映行业隔离和附加工人效应；（3）年轻工人反应最持久，影响可持续长达8年，符合人力资本侵蚀导致的滞后效应；（4）低教育程度和非本地工人承受不成比例的就业成本；（5）总体宽松度指标可能遗漏重要的分配维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为劳动力参与率的周期行为提供了欧盟区域层面的系统性证据，补充了以美国为主的既有文献；揭示了总体参与率韧性背后的人口异质性机制（行业隔离、附加工人效应、人力资本侵蚀和滞后效应）；为理解劳动力市场的周期-结构互动提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对货币政策制定者而言，总产出缺口等总体宽松度指标可能低估了劳动力市场的实际松弛程度；对财政政策而言，需要针对受冲击最严重的群体（年轻、低教育、非本地工人）设计定向支持；对结构性政策而言，行业隔离和技能错配问题需要中长期干预。

title: Lagged and Non-Linear Climatic and Environmental Determinants of Malaria Incidence in Sindh, Pakistan: A Distributed Lag Nonlinear Modelling Study
affiliations: University of Karachi, People’s Primary Healthcare Initiative, Aga Khan University, PATH, University of Karachi, People’s Primary Healthcare Initiative, People’s Primary Healthcare Initiative, Aga Khan University - Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine, Northumbria University, PATH, Fudan University - Key Laboratory of Public Health Safety and Aga Khan University

detail.title: Lagged and Non-Linear Climatic and Environmental Determinants of Malaria Incidence in Sindh, Pakistan: A Distributed Lag Nonlinear Modelling Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: Research reported in this study was supported by the Fogarty International Center of the National Institutes of Health under Award Number D43TW012733.

detail.abstract:
Background: Malaria is a major public health problem in Sindh, Pakistan, where seasonal, climatic variability and ecological heterogeneity sustain transmission. Environmental effects are often delayed and non-linear, limiting the value of simple linear models for early warning.

Material and methods: We analysed monthly malaria case counts from 17 high-burden districts of Sindh from 2013 to 2024, linked with satellite/reanalysis-derived temperature, rainfall, relative humidity and normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI). Cross-correlation and Granger causality analyses explored lagged predictive relationships. Distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) estimated exposure-lag-response associations over lags of up to four months, adjusting for seasonality, long-term trends and district-level heterogeneity.

Results: Malaria burden varied substantially across districts, with median monthly cases ranging from 329 in Hyderabad to 5,472 in Sanghar; the all-district median was 1,904 cases. Relative humidity and NDVI showed the most consistent temporal predictive associations. Relative humidity showed significant Granger associations in 15/17 districts and the strongest spatial consistency, while NDVI was significant in 13/17 districts and showed the strongest province-level predictive signal (F=62.44, p<0.001). Rainfall peaked at a two-month lag in the combined analysis (r=0.371, p<0.001), while temperature showed weaker and more heterogeneous associations. DLNM results showed increased malaria risk under humid conditions, with high relative humidity associated with incidence rate ratios of 1.75-1.78 at one- to two-month cumulative lags. High rainfall showed elevated risk at one- to two-month lags (IRR 1.80 and 1.72), while very high temperature was largely suppressive.

Conclusion: Malaria risk in Sindh is shaped by delayed and ecologically mediated environmental processes. Relative humidity and NDVI appear particularly useful for climate-informed early warning, offering an operational lead time of approximately four to eight weeks.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了巴基斯坦信德省17个高负担地区2013-2024年的月度疟疾病例数据，结合卫星/再分析气象数据（温度、降雨、相对湿度、NDVI），通过交叉相关、格兰杰因果分析和分布式滞后非线性模型（DLNMs）评估环境因素对疟疾传播的滞后预测关系。研究发现相对湿度和NDVI是最稳定、最有预测价值的环境指标，高相对湿度在1-2个月累积滞后下与疟疾风险升高1.75-1.78倍相关，可为气候驱动的早期预警提供约4-8周的操作提前期。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦信德省，环境气候因素（温度、降雨、相对湿度、NDVI）如何以滞后和非线性的方式影响疟疾传播风险？哪些环境指标最适合用于疟疾早期预警？
AI.motivation: 疟疾是信德省重大公共卫生问题，该地区季节性、气候变异和生态异质性持续维持疟疾传播。环境效应往往具有延迟性和非线性特征，简单线性模型难以捕捉这些复杂关系，限制了早期预警系统的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境-疟疾传播生态学理论，利用分布式滞后非线性模型（DLNMs）框架，结合格兰杰因果关系和交叉相关分析，揭示气候因素对疟疾传播的延迟非线性影响机制。
AI.method: 收集17个高负担地区2013-2024年月度疟疾病例数据，结合卫星/再分析衍生气象变量（温度、降雨、相对湿度、NDVI）；运用交叉相关分析和格兰杰因果检验探索滞后预测关系；使用DLNMs估计长达四个月滞后的暴露-滞后-响应关联，并调整季节性、长期趋势和地区异质性。
AI.findings: 疟疾负担在地区间差异显著（月均病例从Hyderabad的329例到Sanghar的5,472例）。相对湿度和NDVI显示最一致的时序预测关联：相对湿度在15/17地区格兰杰显著且空间一致性最强，NDVI在13/17地区显著且省级预测信号最强（F=62.44, p<0.001）。降雨在两个月滞后处达峰（r=0.371, p<0.001），温度关联较弱且异质。DLNM结果显示高相对湿度在1-2个月累积滞后与IRR 1.75-1.78相关，高降雨在1-2个月滞后IRR为1.80和1.72，极高温度则主要起抑制作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为环境因素（特别是相对湿度和NDVI）如何通过延迟生态机制塑造疟疾传播动力学提供了实证支持，强调了气候-疟疾关系的非线性和滞后结构，丰富了环境流行病学中DLNM框架在疟疾预警领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 确认相对湿度和NDVI作为疟疾气候预警的关键指标，为信德省提供了约4-8周的操作提前期，有助于公共卫生部门制定基于气候信息的疟疾早期预警系统，指导资源配置和预防干预措施的及时部署。

title: Integrating spatial histological feature-associated modules with habitat radiomics for subtyping thymic epithelial tumors: a retrospective cohort study
affiliations: Jiangxi Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Jiangxi Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Jiangxi Cancer Hospital, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital and Zhejiang Cancer Hospital

detail.title: Integrating spatial histological feature-associated modules with habitat radiomics for subtyping thymic epithelial tumors: a retrospective cohort study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All other authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and approved by the hospital’s ethics committees (JX, 2023ky237; ZJ, IRB-2024-78). This retrospective study was exempt from the requirement for informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Key Project Jointly Constructed by the Ministry and the Province of Zhejiang Medical and Health Science and Technology (No. WKJZJ-260030).

detail.abstract:
Background: Thymic epithelial tumors (TETs) comprise heterogeneous World Health Organization (WHO) histological subtypes with overlapping epithelial cell subtypes and lymphocytic features, making reliable subtype classification challenging. Herein, we integrated spatial organization pathology feature modules with CT habitat radiomics (HR) and knowledge distillation to develop a novel, non-invasive, and repeatable diagnostic model for subtyping TETs.

Methods: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole-slide images (WSIs) and paired preoperative non-contrast-enhanced CT images from multi-center were enrolled in this retrospective study. CONCH-based visual features, four diagnostic semantic prompts, and cellular pathomic features were integrated to derive eight interpretable spatial histopathological feature (SPF) modules and develop the pathology model. CT-based HRs were subsequently trained using deep learning with or without SPF module knowledge to develop models for evaluating prediction performance across multiple datasets.

Findings: Eight SPF modules based on TET pathological diagnostic elements were defined and quantified in each WSI. SPF module-based model achieved subtype-specific areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.703–1.000 in the internal JX test cohort, 0.880–0.978 in the external ZJ cohort, and 0.843–0.939 in the TCGA-THYM cohort. Profiling of the paired CT-based HRs and SPF modules showed differences in correlation between histological subtypes. Sankey diagram and correlation matrix revealed potential digital information across the two modalities. Moreover, the SPF-guided distillation model performed better than the SPF-unguided distillation model in both the JX cohort (0.911 vs 0.832) and ZJ cohort (0.929 vs 0.702), and also outperformed the predictive value of Transfer learning and Multi-task learning.

Interpretation: The modules of spatial-organizational pathological features are a novel digital label that can be used to develop pathological subtype prediction models. The SPF modules may also serve as a bridge to optimize knowledge training for the CT branch, thereby enhancing the specificity and sensitivity of CT-based non-invasive prediction of TET pathological subtypes.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合了空间组织病理特征模块（SPF）、CT影像组学（HR）和知识蒸馏技术，开发了一个新型、无创、可重复的胸腺上皮肿瘤（TET）病理亚型诊断模型。通过多中心数据验证，SPF引导的蒸馏模型在内部和外部队列中均取得了优异的AUC表现。
AI.research_question: 如何利用空间组织病理特征模块与CT影像组学的融合，结合知识蒸馏技术，实现胸腺上皮肿瘤病理亚型的无创、准确分类？
AI.motivation: 胸腺上皮肿瘤（TETs）包含异质性的WHO组织学亚型，亚型间存在重叠的上皮细胞亚型和淋巴细胞特征，使得可靠的亚型分类具有挑战性。需要开发非侵入性、可重复的诊断模型来实现准确亚型分型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间组织病理特征模块（SPF）理论、CT影像组学（HR）框架、知识蒸馏理论以及多模态数字信息融合理论。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究。整合CONCH视觉特征、四种诊断语义提示和细胞病理特征，构建8个可解释的空间组织病理特征（SPF）模块并开发病理模型；随后使用深度学习训练CT影像组学模型，结合或不结合SPF模块知识（知识蒸馏），在多个数据集上评估预测性能。
AI.findings: 8个SPF模块在内部JX队列中AUC为0.703-1.000，外部ZJ队列为0.880-0.978，TCGA-THYM队列为0.843-0.939。SPF引导的蒸馏模型优于未引导模型（JX：0.911 vs 0.832；ZJ：0.929 vs 0.702），也优于迁移学习和多任务学习。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了空间组织病理特征模块作为新型数字标签的概念，证明了SPF模块可作为CT分支知识蒸馏的桥梁，实现跨模态知识迁移，为多模态医学影像融合提供了新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无创、可重复的TET病理亚型诊断模型，避免了侵入性活检，提高了CT影像在TET亚型预测中的特异性和敏感性，具有多中心验证的临床转化潜力。

title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation and Joint Committee on Taxation, US Congress

detail.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
detail.abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in U.S. history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their pre-existing legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short-run, 87% of private income gains flow to the top 10% of the income distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文利用雇主-雇员匹配的税收记录和事件研究法，研究美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业与工人的影响，发现税收削减增加了企业的投资、销售、利润、就业和工资总额，但收益高度集中在高收入工人群体。
AI.research_question: 美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业投资行为和工人收入分配产生了怎样的因果影响？
AI.motivation: 企业所得税削减政策的实际经济效应（尤其是对企业和工人的分配影响）此前缺乏基于大规模行政数据和严格因果识别的研究证据，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业所得税的税收归宿理论和要素分配理论，分析税收削减对企业投资决策和劳动收入分配的影响。
AI.method: 使用雇主-雇员匹配的税收记录数据，采用事件研究方法，比较同一行业内规模相似但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。
AI.findings: （1）税收削减导致企业投资、销售、利润、就业和工资总额增加；（2）收入增长主要集中在高薪工人群体；（3）短期内，87%的私人收入增长流向了收入分配前10%的人群。
AI.theory_contributions: 为税收政策对企业行为和收入分配影响的理论提供基于大规模行政数据的因果证据，深化了对企业所得税削减分配效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估企业所得税削减政策的经济效应和分配后果提供实证依据，有助于设计更具公平性的税收政策。

title:
From European Social Housing Models to Societal Impact in Greece: 
A Policy Pathway for Social Economy-Led Housing
affiliations: University of West Attica (UNIWA) - Department of Business Administration

detail.title:
From European Social Housing Models to Societal Impact in Greece: 
A Policy Pathway for Social Economy-Led Housing

declarations.ethicsApproval: NO ETHICAL ISSUES
declarations.funderStatement: NO

detail.abstract: Europe's housing crisis is placing growing pressure on welfare systems, urban cohesion, and the capacity of low-and middle-income households to secure stable and affordable homes. This paper translates comparative evidence from Vienna, Brussels, Barcelona, and Zurich into a societal-impact pathway for Greece. It asks how social economy organisations, municipalities, and central government could jointly develop housing arrangements that protect long-term affordability while strengthening participation, community stability, and institutional capacity. The analysis draws on comparative public-policy and institutional evidence concerning municipal and limited-profit housing, Community Land Trusts, collaborative housing, and cooperative housing ecosystems. The paper identifies four transferable mechanisms: long-term stewardship of land and housing, limits on speculative gains, participatory governance, and durable public-community partnerships. On this basis, it proposes a phased Greek policy pathway built around pilot sites, access to public and municipal property, transparent beneficiary criteria, technical support, and measurable social outcomes. The anticipated impacts include reduced housing-cost pressure, greater residential stability, stronger community participation, and improved capacity to deliver socially oriented housing. The paper does not present the social economy as a substitute for public responsibility. It positions it as an institutional partner that can help convert public assets and policy commitments into locally governed, socially sustainable housing solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较维也纳、布鲁塞尔、巴塞罗那和苏黎世的住房政策证据，为希腊构建了一个以社会经济组织为核心的阶段性住房政策路径，提出了四项可转移机制：土地和住房的长期托管、限制投机收益、参与式治理以及持久的公共-社区伙伴关系。
AI.research_question: 社会济组织、市政当局和中央政府如何共同发展住房安排，以保护长期可负担性，同时增强参与、社区稳定和制度能力？
AI.motivation: 欧洲住房危机对福利体系、城市凝聚力和中低收入家庭的稳定可负担住房获取造成日益增长的压力，希腊需要将其转化为可操作的社会影响路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较公共政策与制度理论；涉及市政和有限利润住房、社区土地信托、合作住房及合作住房生态系统。
AI.method: 跨国比较政策与制度证据分析，识别可转移机制并设计阶段性政策路径。
AI.findings: 识别出四项可转移机制：长期土地和住房托管、投机收益限制、参与式治理、持久公共-社区伙伴关系；并提出以试点场地、公共和市政财产获取、透明受益人标准、技术支持和可衡量社会成果为基础的希腊分阶段政策路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将四个欧洲城市的住房治理经验转化为可操作的政策机制框架，贡献于社会济在住房治理中作为制度伙伴角色的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊提供了具体分阶段政策路径，预期减少住房成本压力、增强居住稳定性和社区参与，并提升以社会为导向的住房交付能力。

title: The Behavioural Economics of Decision-Making in a Crisis:,Lessons from the Covid Era
affiliations: UNSW Australia Business School, School of Economics and University of Nevada, Reno - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Behavioural Economics of Decision-Making in a Crisis:,Lessons from the Covid Era
detail.abstract: The Covid era provided an exceptional opportunity to record and examine decision-making in a crisis. We analyse the features of decision-making during the Covid era through the lens of behavioural economics. Covid-era decision-making processes and outcomes deviated acutely from what was recommended by Western public health authorities prior to mid-March 2020. We find that several behavioural economics concepts – including several concepts that we each individually identified as important early in the Covid era (e.g., in Foster 2020 and Pingle 2022) – explain why decision-making processes and the decisions made deviated from what had been considered best practice, often producing results that increased harm rather than ameliorating it. We reflect on how we might reduce the chance of repeating the types of mistakes made during the Covid era when a future similar crisis arises. Because human social planners are not immune to behavioural tendencies as economic analysis traditionally assumes, we find that we must plan to address our human frailties if we are to plan and act effectively the next time a crisis looms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为经济学的视角，分析新冠疫情时期决策过程的特点及其与公共卫生权威建议的偏离，并探讨如何减少未来危机中重复类似错误的可能性。
AI.research_question: 为什么新冠疫情期间的决策过程和结果严重偏离了西方公共卫生当局在2020年3月中旬之前的建议？如何减少未来类似危机中重复此类错误的风险？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情为记录和研究危机中的决策提供了独特机会，且疫情期间的决策过程显著偏离了公认的最佳实践，往往增加了伤害而非减轻伤害，因此需要深入分析其背后的行为经济学原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论，包括作者各自在新冠疫情初期识别出的多个行为经济学概念（如Foster 2020和Pingle 2022中提出的概念）。
AI.method: 定性分析，通过对新冠疫情时期决策过程进行行为经济学视角的观察与反思，结合作者各自早期研究成果进行综合分析。作者还反思了如何规划以应对人类自身的脆弱性。
AI.findings: 多个行为经济学概念解释了新冠疫情时期决策过程和决策结果为何偏离了此前被认为的最佳实践，这些偏离常常导致增加伤害而非减轻伤害的后果。由于人类社会规划者并不能像传统经济分析假设的那样免于行为倾向的影响，因此必须规划应对人类自身的弱点，才能在下次危机来临时有效行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学概念系统地应用于分析重大公共卫生危机中的决策过程，扩展了行为经济学在危机情境决策中的应用范围；挑战了传统经济分析中关于社会规划者理性的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生部门及政策制定者在未来危机中改进决策提供了行为经济学视角的反思和建议，强调需要主动规划应对人类认知和行为弱点，以减少重复犯错的可能。

title: Development and Validation of a Questionnaire for Community-based Screening of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome in Women Aged 18-45 Years in Odisha, India: A Validation Study
affiliations: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Institute of Medical Sciences & SUM Hospital, Maharaja Krushna Chandra Gajapati Medical College and Hospital Berhampur, Institute of Medical Sciences & SUM Hospital, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Maharaja Krushna Chandra Gajapati Medical College and Hospital Berhampur, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)

detail.title: Development and Validation of a Questionnaire for Community-based Screening of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome in Women Aged 18-45 Years in Odisha, India: A Validation Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I/We declare no competing interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained from the Institutional Human Ethics Committee of the ICMR-Regional Medical Research Centre (RMRC), Bhubaneswar, Odisha (Approval No. ICMR-RMRC/IHEC-2020/12). Written informed consent was obtained from all participants before participation and enrolment.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Model Rural Health Research Unit (MRHRU), Sheragada, Ganjam, Odisha (Proposal ID: MRHRU/SH/LRAC03/01).

detail.abstract:
Background: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age. Early identification remains challenging, particularly in resource-limited settings with limited access to diagnostic services. This study aimed to develop and validate a simple, symptom-based community screening questionnaire for identifying women at increased risk of PCOS.

Methods: A four-phase development and validation study was conducted. Candidate items were generated through literature review and qualitative interviews with women diagnosed with PCOS. Following content validation by a nine-member expert panel, face validation, and cognitive debriefing, the final questionnaire was administered to 160 women aged 18-45 years in Odisha, India. The 2018 International Evidence-based Guideline for PCOS served as the reference standard. Predictors were selected using bivariate, LASSO, and multivariable logistic regression. Separate universal and married-women prediction models were developed, each with unweighted and integer-weighted risk scores. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, diagnostic accuracy measures, calibration assessment, 2000-bootstrap internal validation, and test-retest reliability.

Findings: The initial pool of 124 items across 13 domains was refined to a 16-item questionnaire covering five domains. Two scoring approaches were developed for universal and married-women models. In the universal model, unweighted and weighted scores achieved AUCs of 0.950 and 0.964, respectively, while the married-women model achieved AUCs of 0.949 and 0.957. At optimal cut-offs, the universal unweighted score showed 96.2% sensitivity and 75.9% specificity, whereas the weighted score achieved 90.4% sensitivity and 87.0% specificity. Calibration assessment demonstrated good agreement between predicted and observed probabilities across both models. Bootstrap validation showed minimal optimism, and both models demonstrated excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.963 and 0.968).

Interpretations: The validated questionnaire demonstrated excellent diagnostic performance, reliability, and feasibility for community-based PCOS screening. This simple, low-cost, non-invasive tool may facilitate early identification and referral, particularly in resource-limited settings. Further external validation is warranted.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发和验证了一种基于症状的社区筛查问卷，用于识别多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）高风险女性。问卷经过四阶段开发（文献回顾、质性访谈、专家内容效度、认知性访谈），最终形成16个条目、覆盖5个领域的工具。在印度奥里萨邦160名女性中验证显示，通用模型和已婚女性模型均达到极佳的诊断性能（AUC 0.949-0.964），灵敏度高达96.2%，重测信度优异（ICC 0.963-0.968），为资源有限环境提供了低成本、非侵入性的PCOS社区筛查工具。
AI.research_question: 如何开发和验证一种简单、基于症状的社区筛查问卷，用于在资源有限的环境中识别PCOS高风险女性？
AI.motivation: PCOS是影响育龄女性的常见内分泌疾病，但在资源有限的环境中，早期识别面临挑战，因为诊断服务获取受限。需要一种简单、低成本、非侵入性的筛查工具来促进早期发现和转诊。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于2018年PCOS国际循证指南作为参考标准，采用问卷开发与验证的方法学框架，包括内容效度、面效度、认知性访谈等经典测量理论方法。
AI.method: 四阶段开发与验证研究：1）通过文献回顾和质性访谈生成候选条目（初始124个条目、13个领域）；2）九人专家小组内容效度、面效度及认知性访谈；3）在印度奥里萨邦160名18-45岁女性中实施问卷；4）采用双变量、LASSO和多变量逻辑回归筛选预测因子，开发通用和已婚女性两种预测模型（分别含无加权和整数加权风险评分），通过ROC分析、诊断准确性指标、校准评估、2000次bootstrap内部验证和重测信度评估模型性能。
AI.findings: 初始124个条目精炼为16个条目问卷（覆盖5个领域）。通用模型中，无加权和加权评分AUC分别为0.950和0.964；已婚女性模型AUC分别为0.949和0.957。在最优点截断值下，通用无加权评分的灵敏度为96.2%、特异度为75.9%，加权评分灵敏度为90.4%、特异度为87.0%。校准评估显示预测与观测概率良好一致，bootstrap验证显示乐观偏差极小，两个模型重测信度优异（ICC分别为0.963和0.968）。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为PCOS社区筛查提供了方法学贡献，演示了如何将经典问卷开发方法（包括LASSO变量选择、多模型比较、bootstrap验证等）系统应用于内分泌疾病筛查工具的开发，并通过通用和已婚女性两种模型的比较，揭示了不同目标人群在筛查特征上的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个简单、低成本、非侵入性的PCOS社区筛查问卷（16条目、5个领域），在资源有限环境中具有极高的可行性和操作便利性，能够促进PCOS的早期识别和及时转诊。研究在印度奥里萨邦的开发验证为其他资源受限地区的应用提供了实证基础，但需进一步的外部验证。

title: Technology and Jobs: Is Automation Increasing Inequality in India? A Panel Data Analysis of Automation, Job Polarization and Income Inequality (2007–2024)
affiliations: Mahatma Gandhi University

detail.title: Technology and Jobs: Is Automation Increasing Inequality in India? A Panel Data Analysis of Automation, Job Polarization and Income Inequality (2007–2024)
detail.abstract: Automation is increasingly transforming the structure of employment, altering the demand for different types of labour and raising concerns about inequality in developing economies. While the literature on technological change and employment is extensive for advanced economies, empirical evidence on the long-run sectoral effects of automation in India remains comparatively limited, particularly with respect to low-skill employment, income inequality, financial conditions, and inter-sectoral spillovers. This study examines whether automation contributes to job displacement and widening income inequality across major sectors of the Indian economy. The analysis covers six sectors—agriculture, manufacturing, construction, retail, IT/BPO, and healthcare—over the period 2007–2024, producing a balanced sector-year panel of 108 observations. A composite sectoral automation index is constructed using sector-specific indicators of technological adoption, with principal component analysis employed to combine standardised components and reduce arbitrary weighting. The empirical framework employs two-way fixed-effects models with sector and year effects, complemented by an instrumental-variable strategy to address potential reverse causality and omitted-variable bias. A Bartik-style shift-share instrument is constructed using sectoral exposure to automatable tasks and foreign robot installation growth. Additional analyses employ method-of-moments quantile regression to examine heterogeneity across the distribution of low-skill employment, while interaction models investigate the roles of sectoral credit access and social protection expenditure. Input-output linkages are further incorporated to identify automation spillovers across sectors.The findings indicate a substantial negative relationship between automation and low-skill employment. The baseline fixed-effects estimates suggest that a one-unit increase in the automation index is associated with a 16.9 percentage-point reduction in the low-skill employment share, while automation increases the high-skill employment share by approximately 4.3 percentage points. The instrumental-variable estimates remain statistically significant, although smaller in magnitude, indicating that the relationship is not driven solely by broader modernisation trends. Automation is also associated with higher income inequality, with the baseline Gini coefficient estimate indicating a statistically significant positive effect. Quantile estimates reveal considerable heterogeneity: the negative effect on low-skill employment becomes stronger at higher quantiles, suggesting that sectors with greater concentrations of low-skill workers are particularly vulnerable to technological displacement. The interaction between automation and the COVID-19 period further indicates that the pandemic intensified automation-related reductions in low-skill employment. Financial conditions also matter: greater sectoral credit availability amplifies the inequality effect of automation, whereas higher social protection expenditure significantly mitigates it. The spillover analysis demonstrates that automation in one sector can reduce low-skill employment in connected downstream sectors, indicating that the effects of technological adoption extend beyond the sectors in which automation occurs directly.The study concludes that automation in India is associated not merely with technological upgrading but with a significant restructuring of empl

AI.tldr: 本文利用2007-2024年印度六大部门的面板数据，构建部门级自动化指数，采用双向固定效应模型、工具变量（Bartik shift-share）、分位数回归和投入产出联动分析，发现自动化显著降低印度低技能就业份额（每单位自动化指数下降16.9个百分点），提升高技能就业份额约4.3个百分点，并加剧收入不平等。信贷可得性放大不平等效应，社会保障支出可缓解之；自动化效应还会通过产业关联向下游部门溢出。
AI.research_question: 自动化是否导致印度主要经济部门的就业替代和收入不平等扩大？自动化对低技能就业、收入分配、金融条件及部门间溢出效应的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 现有关于技术变迁与就业的文献主要集中在发达经济体，印度作为发展中大国，其自动化的长期部门层面效应（尤其是对低技能就业、收入不平等和部门间溢出的影响）缺乏系统性实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术进步与就业替代理论、技能偏向型技术变迁理论、收入分配理论、投入产出溢出理论
AI.method: 基于2007-2024年印度六大部门（农业、制造业、建筑业、零售、IT/BPO、医疗）构建108个观测值的平衡面板；使用主成分分析构建合成部门自动化指数；采用双向固定效应模型（部门+年份）；使用Bartik式shift-share工具变量处理内生性；运用矩方法分位数回归检验异质性；使用交互模型考察信贷可及性与社会保障支出的调节作用；通过投入产出关联分析跨部门溢出效应。
AI.findings: （1）自动化指数每增加一单位，低技能就业份额下降16.9个百分点，高技能就业份额上升约4.3个百分点；IV估计结果显著但幅度较小。（2）自动化显著提高基尼系数，加剧收入不平等。（3）分位数回归显示，低技能就业集中度越高的部门，自动化对低技能就业的负面影响越强。（4）COVID-19期间自动化对低技能就业的负面效应被进一步放大。（5）信贷可及性放大自动化的不平等效应，而社会保障支出显著缓解之。（6）自动化在某一部门的效应会通过投入产出关联向下游部门传导，减少其低技能就业。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了技术变迁与就业关系的研究至印度这一发展中经济体情境，将自动化效应延伸至部门间投入产出溢出的分析框架，并整合了金融条件与社会保障等制度因素对自动化不平等效应的调节机制，丰富了技能偏向型技术变迁理论在发展中国家的适用性讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家制定自动化时代的就业政策提供了实证依据：提示政策制定者需关注高技能部门低技能集中部门的就业脆弱性，加强社会保障支出以缓解自动化带来的不平等效应，并考虑到自动化通过产业关联产生的跨部门就业冲击，制定系统性的产业与劳动力政策。

title: The social cost of plastic waste
affiliations: University of Strasbourg

detail.title: The social cost of plastic waste
detail.abstract: We integrate material flows into a growth model and derive a formula for the social cost of waste. We calibrate the model on historical plastic use data, which show sharply increasing plastic dependency and substantial future income losses due to plastic waste if not addressed. The social cost of plastic waste is in the range of plastic market prices and rises sharply. Our results indicate a need for urgent policy intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将物质流整合进经济增长模型，推导出废弃物社会成本的公式，并基于历史塑料使用数据进行校准。研究发现塑料依赖度急剧上升，若不加以干预，塑料废弃物将造成巨大的未来收入损失。塑料废弃物的社会成本处于塑料市场价格范围内且迅速上升，表明亟需紧急政策干预。
AI.research_question: 塑料废弃物的社会成本是多少？其如何随时间和经济结构变化而变化？
AI.motivation: 塑料废弃物问题日益严峻，但现有文献缺乏将物质流纳入经济增长框架来系统估算废弃物社会成本的研究，无法为政策制定提供数量化依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长模型与物质流分析（Material Flow Analysis）的整合框架，推导出废弃物社会成本的解析公式。
AI.method: 理论建模：将物质流纳入增长模型并推导社会成本公式；实证校准：使用历史塑料使用数据对模型进行参数校准和模拟。
AI.findings: （1）塑料依赖度呈急剧上升趋势；（2）若不干预，塑料废弃物将导致显著的未来收入损失；（3）塑料废弃物的社会成本与塑料市场价格处于同一量级且快速上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在增长模型的框架内系统推导废弃物社会成本的显式公式，建立了物质流与经济产出、福利之间的理论关联，为环境经济学的废弃物定价理论提供了新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为塑料废弃物政策干预提供了量化依据，表明当前塑料市场价格未充分反映其社会成本，需紧急采取政策行动（如征税、管制或替代方案）来纠正市场失灵。

detail.title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All findings, interpretations, and conclusions of this paper represent the views of the authors and does not represent official views of the above-named institutions. © 2026 Pension Research Council of the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. publicationDetails.detailsText: Wharton Pension Research Council Working Paper No. 3
publicationDetails.journalName: Wharton Pension Research Council / Boettner Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pension as a long-term investor group implies a lower cost increase in response to new debt issuance, but it may come at a cost of higher yield sensitivity to global uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球养老金基金资产配置的演变，发现两个重要的结构性变化：养老金投资者从固定收益证券转向风险更高的投资（共同基金和另类投资），并探讨了全球利率下降作为这一变化的驱动因素及其对借贷成本的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球养老金基金资产配置如何演变？利率下降是否是养老金资产配置从固定收益转向风险资产的主要驱动因素？这些趋势对借贷成本有何影响？
AI.motivation: 养老金部门是全球金融市场的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的关键持有者。理解其资产配置的演变对于评估借贷成本和金融市场稳定性具有重要意义，但现有文献对养老金资产配置的结构性变化及其驱动因素缺乏系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产配置理论，探讨利率环境变化（利率下降）如何影响养老金投资者在固定收益证券与风险资产之间的投资组合选择。
AI.method: 使用全球样本数据，分析养老金基金资产配置的时间演变趋势，区分DC（固定缴费）和DB（固定受益）计划以及不同国家组别；通过回归分析检验本地货币政府债券收益率下降与养老金资产配置变化之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券转移，该趋势在DC和DB计划以及不同国家组别中均稳健存在；（2）养老金将配置转向共同基金中的风险投资以及另类投资；（3）本地货币政府债券收益率下降与较低的债券养老金组合份额和较高的共同基金及外国资产持有份额相关；（4）养老金长期投资者持有份额的下降意味着新债务发行时成本上升幅度较小，但可能以对全球不确定性更高的收益率敏感性为代价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资产配置理论提供了新的经验证据，揭示了利率环境变化对养老金投资组合结构性调整的驱动作用，并阐明了长期机构投资者行为变化对金融市场的理论含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了养老金资产配置趋势的系统性洞察，有助于理解借贷成本的变化机制以及养老金投资者行为对全球金融市场稳定性的潜在影响。

title: Socioeconomic Inequality in Anemia Severity among Women in the Terai Region  A Concentration Index Approach
affiliations: Patna University and Deen Dayal Upadhyay Gorakhpur University

detail.title: Socioeconomic Inequality in Anemia Severity among Women in the Terai Region  A Concentration Index Approach
detail.abstract: ​Background:   Anemia remains an important public health concern among women, with the burden often greater among socioeconomically disadvantaged populations. Examining the socioeconomic distribution of anemia severity can provide information beyond overall prevalence and help identify groups that bear a disproportionate burden.Objective:       This study assessed wealth-related socioeconomic inequality in anemia severity among women in the Terai region and examined whether the observed pattern was consistent with socioeconomic differences in severe anemia.Methods:         The study used secondary data from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019–21), restricted to women aged 15–49 years residing in the Terai region. Anemia was classified as severe, moderate, mild, or non-anemic according to hemoglobin-based criteria. Household wealth quintile was used to rank socioeconomic position. Weighted descriptive analysis and multinomial logistic regression were used to describe socioeconomic differences in anemia severity, and concentration-curve analysis with the concentration index (CI) was used to quantify wealth-related inequality.Results:           Overall, 56.4% of women were anemic: 25.8% had mild anemia, 28.5% had moderate anemia, and 2.1% had severe anemia. In the regression analysis, women in the poorest wealth quintile had higher odds of severe anemia than women in the richest quintile (AOR = 2.20, 95% CI: 1.09–4.45). Urban residence was associated with lower odds of severe anemia (AOR = 0.50, 95% CI: 0.29–0.87). After additional adjustment for BMI, the wealth association was attenuated (AOR = 1.95, 95% CI: 0.95–3.98), while BMI remained associated with severe anemia (AOR = 0.96, 95% CI: 0.93–0.99). The concentration curve indicated a pro-poor distribution of anemia, and the final concentration index was −0.0137.Conclusion:     Anemia among women in the Terai region shows a socioeconomic gradient, with a greater burden of severe anemia among women from poorer households.
